caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical container with a slightly domed, elevated lid featuring an ornate finial at the top resembling a textured fruit or pinecone with small leaves at the base. The surface of the container is smooth, and there is a decorative border along the edges of both the lid and the base. The central portion of the container’s body displays an engraved crest in the shape of a shield, flanked by floral or leafy garlands that extend horizontally. The crest includes a ribbon at the top with two small circular accents above it, and within the shield, there appear to be cursive initials, although they are not entirely legible. The medium of the image is monochrome, rendered in pencil or graphite on a lightly yellowed background, and shading is used to indicate form and texture. The lower left of the drawing contains a small inscription reading "Methalas - ŹUPA."
title: Silver Tea Caddy
